question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Feeble
solution:
The correct answer is "**Strong**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given word.
 
 
• **Feeble**: lacking physical strength, especially as a result of age or illness.
 
 
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given options.
 
 
• **Wild**: (of an animal or plant) living or growing in the natural environment; not domesticated or cultivated.
 
• **Fickle: **changing frequently, especially as regards one's loyalties or affections.
 
• **Strong: **having the power to move heavy weights or perform other physically demanding tasks.
 
• **Fast: **moving or capable of moving at high speed.
 
 
 
• As per the meaning of the given words, "**strong**" is the antonym of "feeble".
 
 
• **Example**: *The center-back of the university football team was a **strong **__lad.*
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is **option 3.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] __Hinglish__** 

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given word.
 
 
• **Feeble**: शारीरिक शक्ति की कमी, विशेष रूप से उम्र या बीमारी के परिणामस्वरूप।
 
 
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given options.
 
 
• **Wild**:(किसी जानवर या पौधे का) प्राकृतिक वातावरण में रहना या बढ़ना; पालतू या खेती नहीं।
 
• **Fickle:**** **बार-बार बदलना, विशेष रूप से किसी की वफादारी या स्नेह के संबंध में।
 
• **Strong:**** **भारी वजन उठाने या अन्य शारीरिक रूप से मांगलिक कार्यों को करने की शक्ति होना।
 
• **Fast:**** **तेज गति से चलने या चलने में सक्षम।
 
 
 
• As per the meaning of the given words, "**strong**" is the antonym of "feeble".
